# Jetforge Labs

> Jetforge Labs is a small studio that makes apps for the little things that eat your time: remembering, typing, checking. It also builds a few custom tools for others.

Jetforge Labs OÜ is a small studio. Everything is built, shipped and supported by the same people.

## Apps

All apps are free downloads for the Mac, notarized by Apple, and update themselves. Download page: https://jetforgelabs.com/apps

- **Checkmate:** a task list for your Mac. No account needed, syncs through your iCloud, free. macOS 15+.
- **Dilo:** writes what you say in any app, and turns calls into notes. On your Mac. macOS 26+, the basic version is free, Pro is a paid upgrade. https://getdilo.co
- **LimitBar:** shows your Claude Code and Codex limits in the menu bar. For developers. macOS 14+, free.
- **Berth:** a Dock for your Mac that stays out of the way, with live window previews and a shelf. macOS 15+, free.
- **Macbrow:** turns the notch into a shelf for your files, what's playing and your next event. macOS 15+, free.
- **DeepSpy:** finds what's eating your disk and cleans it up: a space map, junk finder and app uninstaller. macOS 15+, free.
- **Tide:** a modern terminal for your Mac, built native. macOS 15+, free.

## Custom software

If the friction is bigger, or specific to your team, we can build that too: a tool for how you work, an internal app, a product of your own. Write to hello@jetforgelabs.com.
